mapper.select: SELECT status_code AS statusCode, threshold_days AS thresholdDays, action AS action, enabled AS enabled, start_value AS startValue FROM cage_alert_default

SELECT region_type AS regionType, region_id AS regionId, status_code AS statusCode, threshold_days AS thresholdDays, action AS action, enabled AS enabled, start_value AS startValue, configured_by AS configuredBy FROM cage_region_alert_rule WHERE (region_type, region_id) IN
(#{r.regionType}, #{r.regionId})
ORDER BY status_code ASC
SELECT DISTINCT region_type AS regionType, region_id AS regionId FROM cage_region_alert_rule
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cage_alert_default (status_code, threshold_days, action, enabled, start_value, updated_at) VALUES (#{statusCode}, #{thresholdDays}, #{action}, #{enabled}, #{startValue}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE threshold_days = VALUES(threshold_days), action = VALUES(action), enabled = VALUES(enabled), start_value = VALUES(start_value), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cage_region_alert_rule WHERE region_type = #{regionType} AND region_id = #{regionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cage_region_alert_rule (region_type, region_id, status_code, threshold_days, action, enabled, start_value, configured_by, updated_at) VALUES (#{regionType}, #{regionId}, #{statusCode}, #{thresholdDays}, #{action}, #{enabled}, #{startValue}, #{configuredBy}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE threshold_days = VALUES(threshold_days), action = VALUES(action), enabled = VALUES(enabled), start_value = VALUES(start_value), updated_at = NOW()
